items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, we were talking about him last night, Professor Mineta, said he lived up around Louisiana Avenue a block from there. Who that? That's where I knew him.

ctx.x: No, no, Seussberry, he lived in Seussberry. He died, he'd been there a good while now. He was old, he was one of them old timers.
You know, we were talking about him last night, Professor Mineta, said he lived up around Louisiana Avenue a block from there. Who that? That's where I knew him.

Who that, Jack? Yeah, right. Jack Carey. He bought a house in Seussberry. You know where the hour club is? Yeah. You live by three doors from the hour club. I was there. Three doors from the hour club.
